description: Lady Chancellor Hill/Breezy Hill is well-known to fitness enthusiasts. It is a must walk, run, jog, hike or bike where visitors are awarded with a scenic lookout of St. Ann's, the Queen's Park Savannah, Port of Spain and on clear days, even Central and South Trinidad on the horizon. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
